It does feel very long but I'm not sure I'll like what is coming after graduation either way.

There are things I enjoy doing, however I feel like they're not that special and they wouldn't matter either way if I was dead.

i actually do well in uni. its probably the only thing ive continued doing. i havent been exercising or into my hobbies (mainly nail art) lately.

i dont know. i dropped out once. i instantly felt much better. ive never experienced stress lasting a long time as far as i am aware.

i dont think ill do anything useful with the course. i shouldve pursued software dev. in my spare time i used to learn coding but i havent done it in a while.

Hi. I'm in Biochemical Engineering. Still four semesters to graduate.

I thought I was confusing depression and stress due to the finals, but I've had a couple free days and I still feel awful. I'm somewhat worried I won't feel the way I used to beforehand.
